changes.text: 一种解释是（作者推断），海洋营不是他第一次决定停下。行军第二天早上，雪大得看不清路，他就决定不拔营；天晴一些后探到一块好走的浮冰，午饭后又继续走。两次决定都在衡量眼前的路还能不能走下去。扎营等待也不是新想法：在第一个营地，冰面一夜裂开两次；那一夜之后，他已经写下过在最近的厚浮冰上扎营、等浮冰外漂到开阔水面的方案。但他确信应当先尝试行军，还特别提到这个问题有心理层面的考虑：让大家觉得自己正在朝陆地走，比坐等漂流要好。海洋营是在四天苦干之后回到这个先前否决过的方案。营地选在更结实的浮冰上，理由里挂着一个具体的指望：附近可能开出水道，那时可以划船去找陆地。等条件更有利，再做第二次尝试。

One reading, and it is the author's, is that Ocean Camp was not the first time he chose to stop. On the march's second morning, with snow too thick to see a path, he decided not to strike camp; when it cleared and a good floe turned up, they moved on after lunch. Both decisions turned on whether the way ahead could be made. Nor was camping to wait a new idea. At their first camp the ice split twice in one night. After that night he had already written down the option of camping on the nearest heavy floe and awaiting the outward drift of the pack to open water. But he felt sure it was right to attempt a march first, noting that there was a psychological aspect too: the men would be better off feeling they were on their way to land than simply sitting and waiting for the drift. Ocean Camp, after four days of hard effort, was a return to that option he had set aside. The camp went onto a more solid floe, and the reasoning carried a specific hope: leads opening nearby, boats in the water, land to the north-west. A second attempt was to follow once conditions improved.
于是有了那个读完忘不掉的细节：金币被扔掉，照片被留下。亚历山德拉王后赠给船一本圣经，里面有她的亲笔字迹；他从这本圣经上撕下了扉页，还撕下了约伯记中的一页。

And so the detail that stays with you: "sovereigns were thrown away and photographs were kept." Queen Alexandra had given the ship a Bible with her own writing in it. He tore the fly-leaf out of it, and also a page of Job.

dispositions.rationale: S-E19 原文提到冰面在第一个营地的夜里裂开过两次，可见这段文字写于第一夜之后，不在行军开始前。已把中英文的“行军开始前 / Before the march began”改为“在第一个营地的那一夜之后 / After that night”。原来的“他就写下过”改为“他已经写下过”，不再暗示比第二天早上的决定更早。

evidence.quote: it would also minimize the peril of the ice splitting under us, as it did twice during the night at our first camp

dispositions.rationale: 逐条核对了补入的摘录。S-E23 的越冬备选已写进 context.0。S-E21 的第二次尝试与转入耐心营已写进 story.13。S-E19 的先前否决方案已写进 analysis.0，本轮又修正了其时间顺序。S-E20 的理由已写进 analysis.2。仍缺的是 S-E20 记载的约伯记那一页：已在 story.1 中英文补上，同时补全王后的名字，并在 story.1 的 ev 中加入 S-E20。S-E22 只是可选补充，现稿与它不矛盾，不作改动。

evidence.quote: and also the wonderful page of Job containing the verse
there was no alternative, therefore, but to camp once more on the floe
Should the landing be made too late in the season, the party will go into winter quarters
